paragraphs.text:
The plane has been abandoned, but it looks in good condition. A 
tempting thought enters your mind: steal it. If you have five or more 
percentiles in Pilot (Aircraft), you can check out the plane and get 
it started, go to 98. Otherwise, return to the airport entry at 181. 
(44, 181)
Lydia Lau
